summary: Implementation plan for refactoring the Training Africa Academy UI and CSS into a high-trust EdTech & corporate training platform with Option A (Refined Crimson & Charcoal) default palette + Option B (Institutional Green & Gold) live theme switcher, glassmorphism top navbar, split-screen architectural hero, asymmetric Who We Are bento section, separate 3-column SETA Accredited and Short Courses grids, Other Services & Gallery views, 4-column charcoal footer, and floating WhatsApp + Live Chat actions.
